officialOpenDataItem.title: Parcel
officialOpenDataItem.description: A polygon feature class of the property ownership boundaries as defined by legal description and deeds; used for maintaining property boundaries throughout Miami-Dade County.
officialOpenDataItem.accessInformation: Miami-Dade County GIS Technical Support Group
officialOpenDataItem.licenseInfoAssessment: Item licenseInfo contains an as-is/accuracy and reliance disclaimer only. It names no Creative Commons or other reuse license, no redistribution terms, and no required attribution wording. No separate parcel-specific reuse license URL was exposed in the item metadata. Do not label CC BY/open license from this evidence alone.

otherOfficialReuseSources.title: Miami-Dade GIS Data Service / request GIS data
otherOfficialReuseSources.statement: Most publicly available production GIS data can be downloaded for free from the Miami-Dade County Open Data Hub.
otherOfficialReuseSources.assessment: Confirms free access for public production data, but does not state a data reuse or attribution license.

otherOfficialReuseSources.title: Miami-Dade County website disclaimer and user agreement
otherOfficialReuseSources.assessment: General county website use terms; not a parcel-specific data reuse license.

otherOfficialReuseSources.title: Miami-Dade GIS/Esri Data Terms of Use addendum in GIS procurement item 231654
otherOfficialReuseSources.assessment: Esri software-contract addendum contains restrictions on use of licensed data with Esri software. Its scope appears contract/software-specific; it is not evidence that those terms govern the public Open Data Hub parcel item.

testedEndpoints.role: Feature layer referenced by official Open Data Hub item

identityAndCoverageLimits: FOLIO is explicitly a native 13-character string and must retain leading zeroes; quoted equality worked on both endpoints.
The 38-feature small bbox sample has no null/blank/non-string or repeated FOLIO values, but this does not establish global non-nullness or uniqueness.

OBJECTID is the unique indexed object identifier in the original layer metadata; FOLIO did not have a uniqueness constraint/index in the inspected layer metadata. Do not claim global FOLIO uniqueness without a full or aggregate duplicate audit.
The sample contains Polygon geometries only; it does not rule out MultiPolygon results elsewhere or demonstrate multipart FOLIO semantics.
Dataset extent and description support Miami-Dade County scope, not the full Miami metropolitan region across neighboring counties.
description: Bounded source, native identity, paging and published data-term checks for Miami-Dade parcels.
selection: Use the County public service for the prototype, link its published disclaimer, and do not claim a named open-data licence.

duplicateFolioGroups.interpretation: Two distinct Polygon features share one FOLIO and are spatially distinct, confirming FOLIO cannot serve as a row identity.

wholeLayerDuplicateGlobalIdAggregate.method: group by GLOBALID; count OBJECTID; HAVING COUNT(OBJECTID) > 1

distinctCountStatisticAttempt.error: HTTP 200 ArcGIS JSON error 400: Invalid or missing input parameters.

globalIdentityChecks.distinctIdentityConclusion: The full-layer duplicate-group aggregate returned no duplicate GLOBALIDs and all 596304 rows have non-null GLOBALID; this supports one-to-one identity in the current layer response, but is not a DB uniqueness constraint (metadata index isUnique=false).

wholeLayerFolioChecks.note: FOLIO is a 13-character string field but is neither non-null at semantic level (empty strings occur) nor row-unique.

rowIdentityFollowup.adapterIdentityRecommendation: For the fixed original MapServer source, identify each returned parcel feature by braced uppercase GLOBALID (native esriFieldTypeGlobalID, a 38-character textual value). Preserve FOLIO as an attribute only. Configure a string id pattern matching braces and UUID hex/hyphen form; SQL-quote GLOBALID values. Do not switch endpoint silently; evidence here is for the original MD_PA_PropertySearch MapServer layer.

canonicalIdentity: US-FL-MIAMI-DADE- followed by the exact brace-wrapped GLOBALID. FOLIO is display-only and can be repeated or blank.
